blocks.zh: 第一節：原則、規劃與確效階段
blocks.en: Section 1: Principles, Planning and Qualification Stages

blocks.zh: 本節學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 PIC/S Annex 15 的適用範圍及品質風險管理在確效生命週期中的核心地位
blocks.en: Understand the scope of PIC/S Annex 15 and the central role of quality risk management in the validation lifecycle

blocks.zh: 掌握驗證主計畫（VMP）的構成要素及其組織管理功能
blocks.en: Understand the elements of the Validation Master Plan (VMP) and its organizational function

blocks.zh: 熟悉文件管理要求：協議、偏差、報告核准的流程規範
blocks.en: Become familiar with the documentation requirements: the process for approving protocols, deviations and reports

blocks.zh: 了解確效階段（URS → DQ → FAT/SAT → IQ → OQ → PQ）的邏輯順序與各階段測試要點
blocks.en: Understand the logical sequence of the qualification stages (URS → DQ → FAT/SAT → IQ → OQ → PQ) and the key tests at each stage

blocks.zh: 理解條件性放行的適用情境與風險評估文件要求
blocks.en: Understand when conditional approval applies and the risk assessment documentation it requires

blocks.zh: 原則與一般規定 — Lifecycle approach & risk-based qualification
blocks.en: Principles and General Requirements — Lifecycle approach & risk-based qualification

blocks.zh: 原則與適用範圍解析
blocks.en: Principles and Scope Explained

blocks.zh: 適用對象
blocks.en: Who it applies to

blocks.zh: 本附錄適用於所有用於藥品製造的廠房、設備、公用系統（水、蒸汽、空氣等）及製程。亦可作為原料藥（Part II）的補充指引，但不增加額外要求。
blocks.en: This Annex applies to all facilities, equipment, utility systems (water, steam, air, etc.) and processes used in the manufacture of medicinal products. It may also serve as supplementary guidance for active substances (Part II), but it does not add further requirements.

blocks.zh: 回顧性確效已不被接受
blocks.en: Retrospective validation is no longer accepted

blocks.zh: 2023年版明確廢除回顧性確效（Retrospective Validation）。所有製程必須採用前瞻性或持續性確效方法。這是與舊版的重要差異。
blocks.en: The 2023 version explicitly removes retrospective validation. All processes must use a prospective or continuous validation approach. This is a key difference from the earlier version.

blocks.zh: 比喻：建築藍圖的邏輯
blocks.en: Analogy: the logic of a building blueprint

blocks.zh: 確效就如蓋房子：先畫設計圖（URS/DQ）→ 驗收建材安裝（IQ）→ 測試所有系統運作（OQ）→ 確認住人後功能正常（PQ）。每一步都有文件存證，品質從設計端就被建入，而非最後才驗收。
blocks.en: Validation is like building a house: draw the design first (URS/DQ) → check the materials and installation (IQ) → test that all systems operate (OQ) → confirm that everything works once people live in it (PQ). Every step is documented, so quality is built in from the design stage rather than inspected in at the end.

blocks.zh: 電腦化系統同樣需依 Annex 11 規定進行確效，並應參考 ICH Q8（藥品開發）、Q9（品質風險管理）、Q10（藥品品質系統）、Q11（原料藥開發）。
blocks.en: Computerized systems must likewise be validated in accordance with Annex 11, with reference to ICH Q8 (Pharmaceutical Development), Q9 (Quality Risk Management), Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System) and Q11 (Development and Manufacture of Drug Substances).

blocks.zh: 若引用外部機構（如供應商、CRO）的確效數據，需有充分文件證明數據的完整性與管控措施在資料取得期間均有效執行。
blocks.en: If validation data from an external organization (such as a supplier or CRO) is used, there must be sufficient documentation showing that data integrity and control measures were effectively in place throughout the period in which the data was obtained.

blocks.zh: 組織與規劃 — Validation Master Plan (VMP)
blocks.en: Organizing and Planning — Validation Master Plan (VMP)

blocks.zh: VMP 規劃要點解析
blocks.en: Key Points of VMP Planning

blocks.zh: 驗證主計畫（VMP）的功能
blocks.en: Function of the Validation Master Plan (VMP)

blocks.zh: VMP 是整個廠址確效體系的「總綱文件」，等同於確效的憲法。它不需要逐一描述每個設備，而是定義系統、政策、責任與策略的框架。具體確效細節在個別確效計畫（VP）中展開。
blocks.en: The VMP is the "master document" of the site's entire validation system, comparable to a constitution for validation. It does not need to describe each piece of equipment individually; instead it defines the framework of systems, policies, responsibilities and strategy. The specific validation details are developed in individual validation plans (VPs).

blocks.zh: 人員資格與品質監督
blocks.en: Personnel Qualifications and Quality Oversight

blocks.zh: 確效人員不一定要隸屬於 QA 部門（如工程部門可主導設備 IQ/OQ），但整個確效生命週期必須有適當的品質監督（quality oversight）。這允許彈性的組織設計，同時維持 GMP 要求。
blocks.en: Validation personnel do not have to belong to the QA department (for example, Engineering may lead equipment IQ/OQ), but there must be appropriate quality oversight throughout the validation lifecycle. This allows flexibility in organizational design while still meeting GMP requirements.

blocks.zh: VMP vs. VP 的層次關係
blocks.en: Relationship between the VMP and VPs

blocks.zh: VMP = 城市規劃藍圖（定義道路系統、分區原則）；VP（個別驗證計畫）= 個別建築的施工圖。VMP 讓稽核員可以快速了解廠址整體確效狀態，VP 則提供每個設備/製程的技術細節。
blocks.en: VMP = a city master plan (defining the road network and zoning principles); VP (individual validation plan) = the construction drawings for an individual building. The VMP lets an auditor quickly understand the overall validation status of the site, while the VP provides the technical details for each piece of equipment or process.

blocks.zh: 數據完整性（§1.8）：確效過程中的所有數據獲取均需有適當的管控機制，確保 ALCOA+ 原則（可歸因、清晰、同步、原始、準確）的落實。
blocks.en: Data integrity (§1.8): all data acquisition during validation must have appropriate controls to ensure that ALCOA+ principles (attributable, legible, contemporaneous, original, accurate) are applied.

blocks.zh: 文件管理，包含 VMP — Protocols, deviations & reports
blocks.en: Documentation, including the VMP — Protocols, deviations & reports

blocks.zh: 確效文件管理解析
blocks.en: Validation Documentation Explained

blocks.zh: 確效文件的三層結構
blocks.en: Three-tier Structure of Validation Documents

blocks.zh: 計畫（Protocol）：確效前制定，定義 CPP、CQA、驗收標準、測試步驟
blocks.en: Protocol: prepared before validation; defines CPPs, CQAs, acceptance criteria and test procedures

blocks.zh: 執行記錄：測試期間填寫的原始數據與觀察
blocks.en: Execution records: the raw data and observations recorded during testing

blocks.zh: 報告（Report）：總結所有結果，對照 AC 得出結論，含異常分析
blocks.en: Report: summarizes all results, draws conclusions against the acceptance criteria (AC) and includes analysis of any anomalies

blocks.zh: 供應商協議使用注意事項（§2.6）
blocks.en: Points to Note on Supplier Protocols (§2.6)

blocks.zh: 廠商提供的確效協議可以使用，但製造商必須先審查其適用性並確認符合內部程序。不能直接簽署執行而未審閱內容。必要時可補充額外測試協議。
blocks.en: A validation protocol supplied by a vendor may be used, but the manufacturer must first review its suitability and confirm that it complies with internal procedures. It must not be signed and executed without reviewing its content. Additional test protocols may be added where necessary.

blocks.zh: 條件性放行（§2.10）Conditional Approval
blocks.en: Conditional Approval (§2.10)

blocks.zh: 這是重要的靈活性條款。當部分 AC 未完全達成或偏差尚未完全結案時，可以有條件地進入下一確效階段，前提是：
blocks.en: This is an important flexibility provision. Where some AC have not been fully met or deviations have not yet been fully closed, it is possible to proceed conditionally to the next validation stage, provided that:

blocks.zh: 有書面的風險評估，說明未解決事項對下一階段無重大影響
blocks.en: there is a documented risk assessment showing that the outstanding items have no significant impact on the next stage

blocks.zh: 條件必須明確記錄在報告或獨立摘要文件中
blocks.en: the conditions are clearly recorded in the report or in a separate summary document

blocks.zh: 需由負責人員正式授權
blocks.en: the responsible person formally authorizes it

blocks.zh: 偏差 vs. 計畫變更的區別
blocks.en: Deviation vs. Protocol Change

blocks.zh: 偏差（§2.7-2.8）：執行過程中發現的不預期事件（測試失敗、AC 未達成）或對已核准協議的重大修改。必須調查根本原因並評估對確效結論的影響。
blocks.en: Deviation (§2.7-2.8): an unexpected event found during execution (a failed test, AC not met) or a significant change to an approved protocol. The root cause must be investigated and the impact on the validation conclusions assessed.

blocks.zh: 計畫變更：協議核准前的修訂，走正常文件審查流程，不需要開偏差。
blocks.en: Protocol change: a revision made before the protocol is approved, handled through the normal document review process; no deviation needs to be raised.

blocks.zh: IQ+OQ 合併（§2.5）：對於簡單設備，可將 IQ 和 OQ 合併為一份文件（IOQ），減少文件負擔，同時仍需涵蓋兩個階段的所有測試要求。
blocks.en: Combined IQ+OQ (§2.5): for simple equipment, IQ and OQ may be combined into a single document (IOQ) to reduce the documentation burden, while still covering all the test requirements of both stages.

blocks.zh: 確效階段：URS → DQ → FAT/SAT → IQ → OQ → PQ
blocks.en: Qualification Stages: URS → DQ → FAT/SAT → IQ → OQ → PQ

blocks.zh: 確效階段總覽
blocks.en: Overview of the Qualification Stages

blocks.zh: §3.1 指出確效活動應考慮從使用者需求規格（URS）到設備生命週期結束的所有階段。以下各子節說明每個階段的主要內容與建議測試項目（實際階段可依個別專案情況調整）。
blocks.en: §3.1 states that validation activities should consider all stages from the user requirements specification (URS) to the end of the equipment's life. The subsections below describe the main content and recommended tests for each stage (the actual stages may be adjusted for individual projects).

blocks.zh: URS、DQ、FAT/SAT 解析
blocks.en: URS, DQ and FAT/SAT Explained

blocks.zh: URS — 品質的源頭
blocks.en: URS — the Source of Quality

blocks.zh: URS 是確效生命週期中最重要的文件之一。它定義了設備/系統必須做到什麼，而不是如何做到。URS 應在採購前完成，並作為後續所有確效活動的參照基準（point of reference）。
blocks.en: The URS is one of the most important documents in the validation lifecycle. It defines what the equipment/system must do, not how it does it. The URS should be completed before purchase and serve as the point of reference for all subsequent validation activities.

blocks.zh: 功能需求（能力、產量、精度）
blocks.en: Functional requirements (capability, throughput, accuracy)

blocks.zh: GMP 合規性要求（材質、清潔性、GAMP 軟體類別）
blocks.en: GMP compliance requirements (materials, cleanability, GAMP software category)

blocks.zh: 安全性要求
blocks.en: Safety requirements

blocks.zh: 環境需求（溫濕度、潔淨等級）
blocks.en: Environmental requirements (temperature and humidity, cleanliness grade)

blocks.zh: FAT vs. SAT 的差異
blocks.en: Differences between FAT and SAT

blocks.zh: FAT（出廠驗收）：在供應商廠內執行，確認設備符合 URS 設計規格。設備尚未安裝於生產環境。
blocks.en: FAT (Factory Acceptance Test): performed at the supplier's site to confirm that the equipment meets the design specifications in the URS. The equipment has not yet been installed in the production environment.

blocks.zh: SAT（到廠驗收）：設備送達製造廠後執行，確認運輸過程未損壞且廠內整合正常。
blocks.en: SAT (Site Acceptance Test): performed after the equipment arrives at the manufacturing site to confirm that it was not damaged in transit and is properly integrated on site.

blocks.zh: §3.6 允許在 FAT 中完成的測試不需要在 IQ/OQ 中重複，前提是能證明功能不受運輸與安裝影響。這是重要的效率優化條款。
blocks.en: §3.6 allows tests completed during FAT not to be repeated in IQ/OQ, provided it can be shown that functionality is not affected by transport and installation. This is an important efficiency provision.

blocks.zh: IQ / OQ / PQ 詳解
blocks.en: IQ / OQ / PQ in Detail

blocks.zh: IQ 重點：校準與材質確認
blocks.en: IQ Focus: Calibration and Materials Verification

blocks.zh: IQ 不僅確認「裝好了」，還需收集所有供應商的操作/維護文件，並完成儀器校準。材質確認（Materials of Construction）對無菌製造特別重要——接觸表面必須符合 316L 不鏽鋼等規格。
blocks.en: IQ does not merely confirm that the equipment is "installed"; it also requires collecting all supplier operation/maintenance documentation and completing instrument calibration. Verification of materials of construction is particularly important for sterile manufacturing, because product-contact surfaces must meet specifications such as 316L stainless steel.

blocks.zh: OQ 重點：最壞情況測試
blocks.en: OQ Focus: Worst-Case Testing

blocks.zh: OQ 必須測試操作範圍的上限與下限（worst case conditions），而非只在正常中間值測試。例如：滅菌器 OQ 需在最小裝載量（最難冷凝）和最大裝載量（最難穿透）兩個條件下測試。
blocks.en: OQ must test the upper and lower limits of the operating range (worst case conditions), not just a normal mid-point value. For example, a sterilizer OQ must be tested under both minimum load (hardest for condensate removal) and maximum load (hardest for steam penetration).

blocks.zh: PQ 完成後解鎖的能力
blocks.en: What Is Unlocked After PQ

blocks.zh: 成功的 OQ 完成後，才能正式確定 SOPs、清潔程序和操作員訓練課程（§3.12）。PQ 是使用實際生產材料或有科學依據的替代品進行，確認設備在真實使用條件下的表現。
blocks.en: Only after successful completion of OQ can SOPs, cleaning procedures and operator training programs be formally finalized (§3.12). PQ is performed using actual production material or a scientifically justified substitute, to confirm equipment performance under real conditions of use.

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車交付的類比
blocks.en: Analogy: delivering a car

blocks.zh: IQ = 交車前確認所有零件安裝正確、里程表已歸零；OQ = 在封閉跑道上測試各種速度、轉彎、剎車極限；PQ = 在真實路況下帶著乘客跑完特定里程，確認舒適、油耗、穩定性均符合承諾規格。
blocks.en: IQ = before delivery, confirm that all parts are correctly fitted and the odometer has been reset to zero; OQ = test various speeds, turns and braking limits on a closed track; PQ = drive a set distance on real roads with passengers, confirming that comfort, fuel consumption and stability all meet the promised specifications.
